explanation: Processor pipelining is a technique that improves the performance of a CPU by overlapping the execution of multiple instructions.  Instead of completing one instruction before starting the next, different stages of instruction execution (fetch, decode, execute, memory access, write back) are performed concurrently on different instructions. This significantly increases Instruction Per Cycle (IPC) and overall throughput.  It's crucial for achieving high performance in modern computer systems.
